correctness.rationale: Differentiating the circular-cap area gives \(C'(d)=-2\sqrt{R^2-d^2}\) and positive second derivative. Stationarity of the sum of three exterior caps therefore equates the positive half-chord weights with the unique positive dependence among the three inward normals, proving proportionality to the opposite side lengths. For the 30-60-90 triangle this reduces the center to the stated one-parameter square-root formulas and a strictly decreasing scalar equation with opposite endpoint signs, hence one root. The submitted inequalities place that root in the regular three-cap regime and exclude all vertices. Brunn--Minkowski concavity of the square root of overlap area upgrades the positive-definite local optimum to the unique global optimum. The inspected checker independently reproduces the root, center, chord ratios, vertex exclusions and asymmetry value; these numerics are diagnostic, not the proof.
